statement: ecdsa.fail-shaped MVP: lower the qubit × Toffoli product for a declared point-addition cost claim. Submit {"qubits": <int>, "toffoli": <int>} (optional "score" must equal the product). Score is qubits*toffoli; lower is better. Baseline 100000, target 10000. This pinned evaluator checks metric shape and the product identity only — it does NOT re-simulate a reversible secp256k1 point-add circuit. Real ecdsa.fail settlement still requires ecdsafail run/submit against the launch harness. See examples/ecdsa-fail/GAP.md.
